l.description: Canonical label: identify the concept, not the observation.

v.description: Canonical value: the observation or factual statement. Preserve distinct years, targets, actuals, populations and measurement bases.

s.description: Canonical subject: the responsible entity or measured population, never an inferred actor.

r.description: Canonical reference: source reference, including an unresolved antecedent phrase when kind is unresolved. Do not invent a reference.

e.description: Canonical evidence_ids: exact identifiers shown in this slice, normally one and at most the supplied max_evidence_ids; cite the smallest local span set that fully supports the record. Never guess or renumber.

et.description: Canonical entity_type: organization, person, location, date, reference, department, regulator, contract or other when explicitly supported; otherwise omit for null.

u.description: Canonical unit: preserve the explicit measurement unit exactly; omit for null.

p.description: Canonical period: preserve the faithful explicit period text; partial dates such as a month, year, FY or quarter belong here, without inventing a complete date. Omit for null.

dt.description: Canonical date_type: explicit only for a complete date; relative for relative timing; inferred only for an inferred deadline or obligation; otherwise omit for null.

dd.description: Canonical due_date: YYYY-MM-DD only when a complete date is explicitly stated and date_type is explicit; otherwise omit for null.

sv.description: Canonical severity: low, medium, high or critical for risks when supported; otherwise omit for null.

mt.description: Canonical metric_type: distinguish actual, target and change when explicit; otherwise omit for null.

vb.description: Canonical value_basis: distinguish total, average and rate when explicit; otherwise omit for null.

ag.description: Canonical aggregation: describe the aggregation only when explicit; otherwise omit for null.

qk.description: Canonical quantity_kind: describe the measurement kind only when explicit; otherwise omit for null.

k.description: Canonical kind: entity, metric, deadline, obligation, risk, fact, definition or unresolved, following the frozen extraction scope and selection rules.

cf.description: Canonical confidence: number from 0 to 1; confidence is not evidence.

a.description: Canonical aliases: only aliases explicitly present in cited spans; never guess abbreviations; use an empty array when irrelevant.
